title: Sam's Chance, and How He Improved It
summary: "Sam's Chance, and How He Improved It" by Horatio Alger, Jr. is a novel written in the late 19th century. He successfully buys a new outfit from a second-hand clothing store, marking the beginning of his transformation. Throughout this opening segment, we see glimpses of Sam's character—his cleverness in haggling for clothes, his unrefined yet earnest nature, and the social challenges he faces as he tries to fit into a new role.
